'''Cari''' was the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Caridan (star)|Caridan]] in the [[Carida system/Legends|Caridan system]],<ref name="WC" /> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Cari had fourteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="WC" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Kyp Durron]], under the influence of the spirit of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], used the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Sun Crusher]] to cause the Caridan star to go [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]],<ref name="CP">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref> destroying the Caridan system. The collection of crimson dust and space [[Gas/Legends|gases]] that remained in the system's place became known as the Carida Nebula.<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|109|Carida Nebula}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Carida system/Legends|Caridan system]], except [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], were designed for the article [[Carida: Heavy Duty]] on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website, compiled by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on [[September 4]], [[2003]].<ref name="WC" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Carida star system in grid square M-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
